P1: 31号道路 is a short, winding path, linking 30号道路 with 桔梗市 to the west. A cave entrance on the route's east side leads to 黑暗洞穴, but the area is difficult to navigate without certain field moves.
D1: Near the sign outside Dark Cave
D2: Southwest side of the pond, on the tree (daily)
D3: South of the pond and the ledge
D6: From the man near the pond, after delivering his friend's 烈雀 from 35号道路
P2: When you enter the gate, 琴音/响 catches up to you and wonders aloud how you got past them. She/He gives you a 对战记录器, a device that can record your Pokémon battles and share the clips with friends, before heading into 桔梗市.
P3: 桔梗市 is an old village surrounded by trees. The city stands between 31号道路 to the east, 32号道路 to the south, and 36号道路 to the west. It is a common destination for new Pokémon Trainers, as a Pokémon academy and the Violet Gym are both located here. A tall building known as 喇叭芽之塔 stands on the north side of town.
M1: 1 只（Egg received from Professor Elm's assistant after receiving the Zephyr Badge; knows Extrasensory）
M2: 1 只（Egg received from Primo, requires individual code）
M3: 1 只（Egg received from Primo, requires individual code）
M4: 1 只（Egg received from Primo, requires individual code）
M5: The same as the traded Pokémon
D7: Held by Rocky, an 大岩蛇 received through a trade
D8: In the clearing near the southern exit, on the tree (daily)
D9: West side of the small gray island in front of Sprout Tower (hidden)
D10: From Gym Leader Falkner, after defeating him
D12: End of the path behind the Pokémon Center (hidden; requires 碎岩)
D13: In the clearing beyond the eastern lake (requires Surf)
D14: In the clearing beyond the western lake (requires 冲浪)
P4: A Juggler can be found standing in front of the Pokémon Center. He gives out three different types of Berry in exchange for a Shard. The type of Berry received depends on the Shard's color.
P5: Visit the Pokémon Center and speak to the man standing next to the PC. He introduces himself as Primo, a TV host from The Show Me Show!. He asks for your opinion of him, as he is a bit of a celebrity. If the [ correct combination of phrases] is selected, you can unlock PC wallpapers or receive Pokémon Eggs. There are eight wallpapers available, as well as three different Eggs: a 咩利羊, a 乌波, and a 熔岩虫.
P6: Visit the house to the southwest of the Pokémon Center to find a boy who would like to trade Pokémon. He is willing to part with his 大岩蛇 in exchange for a 喇叭芽. Bellsprout can be found nearby on Routes 31号道路 and 32号道路.
P7: The local Pokémon academy is run by a man named Earl Dervish, who is initially found standing between the Gym and Poké Mart. Speak to him, and he asks if you have defeated the local Gym; say no, and he leads you to the school while he twirls around at every turn along the way. The school teaches inexperienced Trainers about the basics of battle. A blackboard in the front of the room describes the five status ailments that can affect a Pokémon.
C6:
Damage dealt by physical moves drops to 50%; inflicts damage equal to 1/8 of maximum HP every turn.
火 Pokémon cannot be burned.
C8:
Cannot move until thawed (20% chance of recovery per turn).
冰 Pokémon cannot be frozen.
C10:
速度 drops to 25%; cannot attack 1/4 of the time
地面 Pokémon cannot be paralyzed by 电 moves.
C12:
Inflicts damage equal to 1/8 of maximum HP every turn; Pokémon loses 1 HP for every four steps taken outside of battle.
毒- and 钢 Pokémon cannot be poisoned.
C14: Cannot move for one to four turns.
P8: 喇叭芽之塔 is a large pagoda held together by a flexible pillar that sways from side to side. This flexibility protects the tower from earthquakes and symbolizes the battles occurring on the upper floors. It is inhabited by Sages who study diligently and teach that all living beings coexist through cooperation. It is said that the swaying pillar was once a 100-foot-tall 喇叭芽.
D16: North; south of the northeast stairway
D18: Southwest; north of the western stairway
D22: From Elder Li, after defeating him
P9: The tower is three stories tall. The ground floor is open to tourists, who visit to see the unique style in which the tower is built. Pass by the swaying pillar  and climb the stairs to 2F.
P10: Go east to battle Sage Nico and take the stairs back down to 1F.
P11: Pick up the Parlyz Heal to the south. Head west to battle Sage Chow, then climb up the western stairway.
P12: Grab the 命中强化 to the north, then battle Sage Edmond in the southwest corner. Climb the southern stairway to 3F.
P13: Collect the 伤药 to the west. Continue northward to battle Sages Jin, Neal, and Troy.
P14: When you pass the swaying pillar, you find that 劲敌（西尔弗） has just defeated the elder Sage, Li. He acknowledges Silver's skill as a Pokémon Trainer and hands him a Technical Machine, but warns that he should not treat his Pokémon so harshly. Silver notices you at this point, and complains about the elder Sage being weak. He clearly has no intention of heeding the Sage's warning, as he is only interested in strong Pokémon that can win. He then uses an Escape Rope to leave the tower.
P15: Pick up the 离洞绳 in the northeast corner, then speak to Elder Li. He welcomes you to the tower, and offers to test the bonds between you and your Pokémon.
P16: 草 Pokémon like Li's two 喇叭芽 are vulnerable to 火- and 飞行 attacks, so 波波, 咕咕, and 火球鼠 will have little trouble getting past them. His Hoothoot, a Flying-type Pokémon, takes serious damage from 岩石 attacks.
P17: When the battle is over, Li rewards you with 招式学习器70（闪光）. This field move lights up even the darkest caves, but to use it outside of battle, you must first defeat the Violet Gym.
C15:
Violet City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Falkner
The Elegant Master of Flying Pokémon
P18: The Violet Gym specializes in 飞行 Pokémon. Flying-type moves are super effective against 虫-, 格斗-, and 草 Pokémon, while Flying-type Pokémon are weak to 电-, 冰-, and 岩石 moves.
P19: The Gym's first floor is empty, except for a wooden platform that carries challengers to an upper level. There are two Gym Trainers on this elevated platform, but a semi-transparent walkway allows challengers to reach the Gym Leader directly.
P20: Falkner's 比比鸟 can use 起风 to deal serious damage to 虫 Pokémon, and 草 Pokémon like 菊草叶. It may not be the most difficult Pokémon to defeat, but it is able to use 羽栖 to restore its health and increase its longevity. Flying Pokémon can do little against the high 防御 of 岩石 Pokémon; if you traded for the boy's 大岩蛇, counterattack with 落石 for an easy victory.
P21: After the battle, Falkner awards you the 天空徽章, which ensures obedience of all Pokémon up to level 20 and enables the use of 碎岩 in the field. He also gives you 招式学习器51（羽栖） as a prize.
P22: Professor Elm calls when you step outside the Gym, and says that they have discovered something about the 神奇蛋. He does not go into detail, but wants you to bring the Egg along with you on your travels. He informs you that his aide is in the nearby Poké Mart, and asks that you pay him a visit.
P23: Elm 's aide is waiting for you near the counter. Agree to the professor's request, and he returns the 神奇蛋 to you. It seems that after you left the lab, Elm got a phone call and he soon decided that no one would be more suited to care for an Egg than you. The aide goes on to explain that in order for a Pokémon to grow and hatch from an Egg, it must spend time with other active Pokémon. He then leaves to return to the lab.
P24: When you leave the Poké Mart, you are met by a mysterious girl dressed in a kimono. She notices the 神奇蛋, and realizes that it was passed from Mr. Pokémon, to Professor Elm, to you. She calls it an important Egg and asks that you take good care of it for her, before leaving southward.
